ROW-01.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM t LIMIT 2) AS t;

ROW-02.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM t LIMIT 2) AS t ORDER BY id;

TYPE-02.sql: SELECT COALESCE(flag, CAST(NULLIF('0', '') AS NUMERIC)) FROM (SELECT CAST(1 AS NUMERIC) flag) t;

FMT-01.sql: SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(TRIM_SCALE(CAST(12.34 AS NUMERIC)) AS TEXT), '^(-?)0[.]', '\1.');

FMT-02.sql: SELECT CAST(NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CAST(amount_txt AS TEXT), '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?(nan|inf(inity)?)[[:space:]]*$', '!', 'i'), '') AS NUMERIC) FROM t;

DATE-03.sql: SELECT MAKE_TIMESTAMP((((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer / 100) + (CASE WHEN MOD(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::integer, 100) < 50 THEN -1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100 + 50), 1, 1, 0, 0, 0);
